bootloader.recovery: ROM DFU or SWD via STM32CubeProgrammer

recording_active.action: Stop or save the current recording before starting OTA.

transfer_active.action: Wait for the current recording or diagnostics transfer to finish, then retry OTA.

diag_export_active.action: Let diagnostics export finish before offering OTA.

low_battery.message: Battery is below the OTA safety threshold.
low_battery.action: Charge the pendant above the package battery and voltage minimum before retrying.

wrong_board_target.message: The package targets a different Companion board.
wrong_board_target.action: Choose a package whose board target and MCU match the connected Companion.

invalid_hash.message: The package image hash or size does not match the manifest.
invalid_hash.action: Download or rebuild the package and retry only after the SHA-256 check passes.

interrupted_transfer.message: A previous OTA transfer was interrupted.
interrupted_transfer.action: Resume or discard the interrupted transfer from the host before starting a new OTA.

rollback.notes: rollback is selected with the later ST OTA reference and must not copy ESP bootloader rollback

recovery.factory_reflash: Use STM32CubeProgrammer with the accepted Companion image.
recovery.interrupted_transfer: Report interrupted_transfer and require host recovery before accepting new data.
